body_markdown:
Interactive video is the future. We raised over $10M seed round to build it. Our interactive video model - Lemon Slice 2 - just launched: real-time talking avatars that stream at 20fps on a single GPU from one photo.


Talk to avatars now: lemonslice.com (no signup) Or integrate into your product using our API.


ElevenLabs gave AI a voice. We're giving it a face.


Grateful to[Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/?ref=infinity-blog.ghost.io) ,[Matrix](https://matrix.vc/?ref=infinity-blog.ghost.io) ,[Mantis Venture Capital](https://www.mantisvc.com/?ref=infinity-blog.ghost.io) , Emmett Shear (Twitch Co-founder/CEO), Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox Co-founder/CTO), Jared Friedman, Ilya Sukhar, and everyone backing us - and thanks to Ivan Mehta for the[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/23/lemon-slice-nabs-10-5m-from-yc-and-matrix-to-build-out-its-digital-avatar-tech/?ref=infinity-blog.ghost.io) feature.


PS - We're hiring!


[Lemon Slice nabs $10.5M from YC and Matrix to build out its digital avatar tech | TechCrunch | Digital avatar generation company Lemon Slice is working to add a video layer to AI chatbots with a new diffusion model that can create digital avatars from a single image.](https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/23/lemon-slice-nabs-10-5m-from-yc-and-matrix-to-build-out-its-digital-avatar-tech/?ref=infinity-blog.ghost.io)
